Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production eight-frame cat walk sprite sheet. Input 1 is APPROVED SIDE WALK motion reference: reproduce its exact frame order, leg phase and cadence, but from a three-quarter toward-right view. Input 2 is the current DIAGONAL WALK appearance reference, whose stiff legs must be replaced.
Create ONE 4-column 2-row sheet of exactly 8 orange-white tabby cats on genuinely transparent background, no text, no shadow. Same painted fine outline, colors, head shape, proportions as references. Fixed camera looking three-quarter toward its front, cat walks right and toward viewer along screen vector (1,+0.55). More three-quarter than side reference. Keep torso/head centers identically registered in each cell, same size and ground plane; small 1-2px head bob and shoulder/hip roll only. Do NOT copy the stiff post-like legs from input2.
Critical: WHOLE LIMBS articulate visibly: upper front leg swings from shoulder, elbow bends strongly in recovery, wrist/paw folds back then reaches. Hind thigh rotates from HIP, bent knee and hock make an obvious zigzag when airborne. Near limbs larger, far limbs thinner and partly occluded, four distinct connected limbs. Keep limb lengths constant, no rubber stretching. No straight vertical dangling posts through all frames.
8-frame keypose chart row-major, LEFT means cat's near left limbs:
1 LH plants at front of hind footprint, LF airborne folded backward at elbow with paw lifted 20px, RH in rear stance extended back, RF stance below shoulder.
2 LH load bearing drives back, LF bent elbow swings forward high, RH heel lifts preparing recovery, RF pushes back.
3 LH mid stance, LF reaches forward and PLANTS far in front of shoulder, RH airborne deeply flexed knee/hock paw gathered beneath belly, RF rear stance.
4 LH late stance, LF loads and begins driving back, RH bent swing forward, RF rear toe off and wrist bends.
5 LH toe off deeply flexes hock, LF mid stance, RH plants forward under hip, RF airborne folded backward at elbow with paw lifted.
6 LH bent knee/hock swings forward, LF late stance driving rearward, RH load bearing drives back, RF bent elbow swings forward high.
7 LH airborne gathered under hip finishing swing, LF rear toe off starts folding, RH mid stance, RF reaches forward and PLANTS ahead of shoulder.
8 LH reaches toward its next plant, LF folded swing recovery lifted, RH rear stance extends behind hip, RF loads driving back.
Contacts LH frame1 LF frame3 RH frame5 RF frame7: lateral four-beat walk. NO simultaneous gallop or trot. Distinct full shoulder-to-paw and hip-to-paw silhouettes in every frame. Match side walk's clear foreleg reach and bent recovering leg. Tail makes small drawn motion.
Output 1536x1024, roomy separated cells, full tails ears feet, transparent gaps.
notes: Both selected outputs have native generated alpha; brown RGB in transparent pixels is not a backdrop. Sources are lossless WebP copies, preserving alpha.
